metadata.description: Claude Code mods for the desktop: the file tree inside the Agents pane, the agents panel and a two-line usage band

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: token-weather-usage
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: context tokens with their weather, a bar per recent prompt, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, the prompt cache with its time left, the session cost with the last prompt's share in dollars and in points of the 5-hour limit, and the subagents running. Labels in English or French. After Token Weather (Anthropic, Apache-2.0) and the ideas of usage-meter (HolyGrail) and prompt-cache-control (Daniel San).
